owner.description: Owner identifier to list under; accepts nameservice names (e.g. "alice.dys") or bech32 addresses. Resolution is performed server-side prior to building the range iterator.

index_prefix.description: Index prefix to filter storage entries by; only entries with indexes starting with this prefix are returned.

filter.description: Optional GJSON filter to further filter entries; supports comparison operators (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=) and pattern matching (% for like, !% for not like); only matching entries included in results; max 100 chars.

extract.description: Optional GJSON path to extract from each entry (e.g., "user.name" extracts "jeff" from {"user": {"name": "jeff"}}); transforms data field in response; max 100 characters.

pagination.description: Pagination parameters for result set navigation; supports offset, limit, and key-based pagination.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageLis.title: Query Storage List Request
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageLis.description: QueryStorageListRequest lists storage entries with prefix filtering, GJSON filtering, and extraction. Supports complex queries through index_prefix for efficient range scans, GJSON filter for content-based filtering, and GJSON extract for field-level retrieval. Pagination enables efficient iteration over large result sets.

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

entries.description: List of storage entries matching owner, index_prefix, and filter criteria; data may be transformed by extract parameter.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including next key for continued iteration and total count if requested.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageLis.title: Query Storage List Response
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryStorageLis.description: Response containing list of storage entries matching the query criteria.

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

owner.description: owner is the account address that owns this storage entry.

index.description: index is the key/index for the storage entry (within the owner's namespace).

data.description: data is the stored string value associated with the index.

updated_height.description: updated_height is block height of last modification.

updated_timestamp.description: updated_timestamp is the block time in UTC (RFC3339 e.g. "2025-06-11T15:23:00Z") when entry was modified.

hash.description: hash is SHA-256 hex of data field.
